name: Oklahoma

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Online: up to 2 attempts, then test in person
retake.retakeFee: $4 per prior failed attempt, collected when the credential is issued

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours, 10 of which must be at night
gdl.nightCurfew: Learner permit: drive only 5 a.m.-10 p.m. Intermediate license: no driving 10 p.m.-5 a.m. unless an exception applies.
gdl.passengerLimits: Only one passenger under 18 (other than household members) unless a licensed driver 21 or older is in the front seat

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. birth certificate or passport)
Two proofs of Oklahoma residency (for REAL ID)
process.realIdNotes: Oklahoma offers a REAL ID marked with a star. A REAL ID requires proof of identity, proof of lawful presence, a Social Security Number, and two proofs of Oklahoma residency. REAL ID is required to board domestic flights.
process.permitFee: $42.50 (4-year learner permit); $81.00 (8-year), plus $4 per prior test failure
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.bacLimitUnder21: Any measurable amount (zero tolerance); 0.02% or more triggers suspension
facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: License suspension when 10 or more points accumulate within a 5-year period
facts.moveOverRule: Change lanes away from, or slow down for, stopped emergency, tow, and highway maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights on highways and turnpikes
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 75 mph on rural interstates and turnpikes (unless posted lower)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 25 mph or as posted during school hours when children are present

verifyNote: Official Service Oklahoma pages confirmed the exam, ages, and 4-year permit/license fees, but the cited official pages did not conclusively confirm an 8-year credential fee; only the confirmed 4-year fees are retained.
